Product Specification.value: Multiple device tiers specified including Tier 1 Staff Basic Laptop (Intel i5 14th Gen, min 16GB DDR5 RAM, 512GB NVMe SSD, 13" display, Windows 11/Mac OS, 3-year min warranty), Tier 2 Staff Laptop (Intel i7 14th Gen, min 32GB DDR5 RAM, 1TB NVMe SSD, 13" display, Windows 11/Mac OS, 3-year min warranty), plus student Chromebooks, tablets, desktops, and display monitors.

Bid Summary.value: Dallas Independent School District (Dallas ISD) is soliciting proposals under RFP JA-207652 for student and staff computing devices, including Chromebooks, Windows laptops, tablets, desktops, and display monitors. The initial contract term is 3 years with two successive 1-year extension options, not to exceed 5 years total. The proposal due date is July 9, 2024, at 2:00 PM CST, following a pre-bid meeting held on June 10, 2024. Notable requirements include device deployment services such as software installation, asset decaling, reporting, etching, and delivery, alongside various compliance and documentation submissions.
